purpose: Requirements for DLID-based references, link checking, path-fix notification, section IDs, change impact candidates and notification, and consistency checks over Index target documents.
summary: FR-007: formal references are Markdown reference-link definitions whose title holds a content hash and a DLID
FR-009: link checks search the referenced directory and verify DLID, current path, relative path, and fragment resolution
FR-010: path mismatch notification with confirmed current path, without doc-link rewriting any link
Section 13.1: a section ID (DLID) is placed at the end of every heading, issued only by the DLID assignment operation
FR-013: impact candidates are source documents whose recorded hash differs from the target current hash
FR-014: change impact notification to the project management AI without judging whether fixes are needed
FR-015: notification state is not stored; references are reported until the AI rewrites the title hash after verification
FR-016: consistency check lists missing or duplicate IDs, broken references, path mismatches, and hash differences
Rewrite targets need user confirmation by the project management AI before any document is rewritten
Acceptance conditions AC-003, 004, 006 to 009, 028, 032, 033 for references, impact, and rewrite confirmation
tasks: Implementing link checking (check-links) and reference extraction
Implementing change impact detection (check-impact) and notification
Writing reference links with content hash and DLID in titles
Fixing stale link paths after moving or renaming documents
Designing consistency check output and guidance
Writing tests for reference and impact acceptance conditions
Confirming rewrites of links with the user
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 参照と変更通知
